name: beyondmatch-frontend
description: BeyondMatch static frontend. There is no build step: the site is the HTML, JS and CSS in this folder. `dependencies` is an exact-pinned inventory of the browser libraries the pages load from CDNs or ship in libs/ (the HTML pages and utils.js load the same versions with Subresource Integrity hashes; update both together). `devDependencies` are the lint tools used by `npm run lint` and CI.
